description: Lateral slide leftward of the whole composition: first tree/leaf scene exits left while a second tree composition with locust-like insects enters from the right edge (f7420-7423) and settles; hard cut vs slide cannot be told from 8 tiles.
Blue water plane's top edge rises slowly (about y122->~90 on tile scale) over green field; translucent blue overlays the tree.
Projected skeleton image opens from a thin horizontal line (f7766) to a full rectangle by f7770, then holds.
Projected image holds to f7860 then collapses vertically to a line by f7865; a faint new image smear appears at f7866.
Text '13th cent...' reveals left to right from f8028 to f8033 beside the character; wipe-like, exact mechanism UNAVAILABLE.
Character slides left and slightly down from x~190 to ~100 tile px between f8026 and f8031 then holds.
White/pale background transitions to blue sky and sand across f8088-8092; character stays at left.
Genghis on mount drifts slightly with label static; small settle only.
Figure and label slide off to the left with accelerating motion from f8428 to f8432; f8433 tile blank white.
No change visible in the 8 tiles beyond sub-pixel drift of board; low peak 1.63 is likely texture/pointer jitter (INFERRED).
Genghis on mount and left riders shift position slightly with head bob while the scene slowly enlarges.
Riders at left and Genghis shift a few tile px and Genghis head tilts; corpses do not move.
Close crop drifts slightly right (foreground head x +40 tile px across strip); elements otherwise static.
Same slow drift continues; no new elements.
A robed figure with an arrow in its head tilts back and falls leftwards toward the horse while a second arrow flies in from the right edge across f9052-9057; riders do not visibly move.
A red-fletched arrow appears at right at f9052 and travels leftward/lower across tiles.
Fallen robed figures slide and stack further right of the horse, rotating to horizontal; arrows remain upright. Final tiles show two or three bodies overlapped.

Rider and horse stay fixed in tile; handwritten label "Mongol horse archer" moves vertically in the tile (down f9097-9100, then settling around y~300) and is in view; likely the label sliding/bouncing in. Reveal style cannot be stated.
Rider and horse grow larger across tiles; label and curved arrow move up and exit frame by f9184-9187 (arrow only at f9184), consistent with a push-in.
Empty board at f9354; a dim, small picture appears at f9355, grows and brightens f9356-9358, then settles at f9359-9361 (scale-up fade-in).
Pointer stick tilts and drops toward the lower right across f9358-9361 while the lecturer shifts slightly.
Lecturer shifts rightwards and down in tile and pointer drops to the floor line; painting is static.
Globe with figures grows from small to large tile coverage with figures riding along; globe also shifts left/down.

Text "Estimated deaths: 40 million" is progressively uncovered left-to-right as it emerges from behind the right edge of the globe: "n" at f9520, "illion" f9521, "40 million" f9522, "...aths: 40 million" f9523, nearly full by f9527.
Globe shrinks and moves left across tiles while text emerges.
Lecturer sinks lower behind lectern (f9743-9746) then a green leaf item shows at lectern edge by f9747-9750; board and number static.
Lecturer is standing with torso visible; pointer rotates from low-left (f9758) upward to near-vertical pointing at board by f9764-9765.
Map shifts slightly and box moves leftward/downward in frame; gradual drift across tiles (small displacement).
Strong push-in: box grows from about 60 px to about 130 px tile width, Europe enlarges and background darkens.

Tiles f10292-f10299: quoted text drifts upward (about 58 px in the 480x270 tile, roughly 230 px native by eye) and the bacterium shrinks slightly and shifts; looks like a coordinated drift/scale before the next shot. Motion starts near f10295. Easing unknown.
Mouse enters from bottom edge at f10314, rising across f10315 while the small bacterium sits near its back; at f10316 the mouse is fully in frame, bacterium no longer visible.
Mouse changes scale and position between f10316 (large, upper right) and f10317 (smaller, lower left), reads as a jump rather than continuous motion (adjacent-frame change).
Mouse body turns progressively lighter and pinkish over f10317-f10320, tinted toward pink with decreasing contrast; end point beyond f10320 not viewed.

Floor background cross-fades from light grey-brown to dark brown wood over f10331-f10335; mouse stays about the same position and then holds f10335-f10338. Strip frame count of fade is about 5 frames.
Bearded tunic character appears at the top-right edge at f10349 with head cut off, moves into frame by f10352 and settles near right third; no further motion to f10355 apart from background shift.

Room shifts rightward in frame: table moves right, stool appears at right from f10352 and a window appears at top left by f10354; mouse shrinks and moves left, consistent with a pull-back with pan (INFERRED, parallax not measured).
Both characters hold position; only small gaze and head angle changes between tiles and no camera or background change visible. Low measured pixel difference (1.88).

Handshake pose held with arm line connecting the two characters; scene looks gradually darker from f10620 toward f10627 (cause unverified: overlay, vignette or colour shift). Measured difference is low (1.23).
Close-up face: pupils shift left/right, mouth switches between small open and flat line, head sways slightly; background blur unchanged.
New painting (woman tending a patient) appears from faint at f10859 to near full opacity by f10863 on the classroom board, while expanding vertically; then holds f10864-f10866.
Final tile f10866 looks unchanged from f10864-f10865 (hold).
Push-in: doctor and street elements all grow tile by tile; doctor head moves from lower to upper-centre; a visible zoom in 8 frames (~0.23 s), speed only from tiles.
Globe (and volcano icon) scale up continuously, drift left-to-lower-left and crop at left/bottom edges by f11768; zoom-in on the volcano.
Globe is zoomed out with no volcano icon visible in these tiles; slight drifting right/downward by f11838.
Hard change from the plain blue globe (f11838) to a small cracked, glowing lava sphere on white (f11839), no dissolve visible between tiles.
Cracked sphere shrinks and drifts from upper-centre toward lower-centre/left across five tiles.
Volcano, flames, smoke and lava stream appear unchanged at tile resolution; only a very slight shift possible (MEASURED mean diff 1.15 is small).
Small ash puff above the crater and the text hold constant for three frames.
Ash plume steps up from a short puff to a taller narrow column at f11992 then gets speckled texture by f11996; text unchanged. Abrupt step suggests low-rate drawn animation (INFERRED).
Ash cloud widens and rises further, swallowing the top of the frame; step in size between f12026 and f12027 then continued spread; text and volcano static.
Figure sinks progressively behind the rising dark mound: torso visible at f12139, only head and shoulders by f12146; mound ridge climbs the frame; orange vents shift.
Only head with raised stick arms visible above the mound; head shifts down and sideways; mound edge and vents keep moving. Possible arm flailing (INFERRED).
Small figure bobs vertically and an arm line moves from left to right of the head; trees and sun static; haze unchanged.
Figure walks leftward toward the left tree and bobs, overlapped by the tree trunk at left; haze visibly thicker toward upper-right than earlier.
Left-to-right reveal of "27°F (15°C)": a dot at f12439, "27" at f12440, "27°F (" with clipped parenthesis at f12441, full text by f12442; about 4 frames.
Thermometer and complete text stay the same in tiles after the reveal.
Figure tilts from upright into a sideways lying pose over five frames, rotating toward the cow; trailing stick limbs rotate with it.
Scene scales up: hills, cow and trees are larger and lower in frame by f12741; the camera pushes and shifts down.
Steady push-in on the fallen figure and cow; sky and tree leave the frame, shapes enlarge each tile.
Projected wasteland image collapses vertically (squash) from f12982 and fades to a thin sliver by f12984-85 with the board turning plain green.
Next (mammoth) picture begins to show as a thin faint band at f12986; professor, projector and pointer static throughout.
Ocean wave picture holds through f13100, then collapses vertically and fades by f13103 (squash transition as in the previous strip).
Dead-tree landscape picture appears as a thin band and widens at f13104-05.
Red rectangle and its 3000 label both grow and drift up-left across all 8 tiles with decreasing step size; group scale-up or camera zoom cannot be separated.
evidence_label: OBSERVED (tile positions); INFERRED (decelerating easing read from step sizes)

description: Crowd cluster enters from the right edge: sliver f13354, partial f13355-13356, fully visible by f13357; no 3000 label in any tile.
Whole crowd group continues sliding left and decelerating (tile-local centre x about 295 to 170 of 480) from f13357 to f13361.
Isometric corn plot drops in from top edge: tip at f13555, growing into view through f13558.
Corn plot keeps settling downward with decreasing step (about 25, 15, 5 tile px per frame) and is stationary at f13561-13562; no overshoot seen.
Mammoth static at same position in f13594-13595.
Mammoth slides straight downward and exits the bottom: lower in f13596-13597, mostly out in f13598, head tip in f13599, gone by f13600-13601.
Background fades from mid-grey (f13744) through dark grey (f13746) to near black (f13747) and black (f13748); character stays in place.
Black background and dimmed character unchanged f13748-13751; character also looks darker than in earlier tiles.
Murky beige-teal scene dims progressively tile by tile toward dark; blue patch at top right persists but darkens; no shapes resolved.
Very dark scene fades to near-black by f13953-13954; faint blotches only visible in f13949-13951.
Frames look pure black at tile resolution (labels only).
evidence_label: OBSERVED (downscaled tiles; very dark values may hide residual detail)

description: White text and yet static on black.
Text changes from and yet (f14028) to somehow (f14029) in a single frame step, same centre line; no intermediate wipe seen.
somehow static through f14033; no fade-to-black visible in this strip.
Campfire flame cycles: tall and bright (f14106-14108), drops to medium with detached tongue (f14109-14111), small (f14112-14113); light glow on floor shrinks with it. Characters and cave unchanged.

Flame sequence tall (f14193-14195), medium (f14196-14198), small (f14199-14200), tile-for-tile similar to the f14106 strip; consistent with a looping flame animation 87 frames apart (not verified further).
They didnt give up text static on white.
Phrase changes from They didnt give up (f14260) to when everything else (f14261) in one frame step; no wipe seen.
when everything else static.
Hard change to a much larger DID. in a single frame (f14285 to f14286); no scale animation visible in f14286-14290, text static after.
Push-in from wide classroom (man small at right) to close-up (man fills right half by f14393-14394); head size grows each tile.
subscribe chalk text slides off to the left (full f14387, partial f14389-14391, sliver f14392) while the view moves; consistent with a lateral component of the zoom.
Close-up of the man static across f14523-14524 (very small head movement only).
Pull-back from close-up to nearly wide framing (f14525 mid-zoom, f14526 near wide, f14527 wide).
subscribe chalk text slides back in from the left edge (sliver f14524, partial f14525-14526, full f14527).
Wide framing static; orange trail visible near desk base.
